description: Inflation calculator (any country) — What an amount of money from one year is worth in another year, using the official consumer price index for any country: equivalent amount, cumulative and average annual inflation, purchasing-power change, and the highest and lowest inflation years in the range. Source: World Bank CPI (CC BY 4.0). Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
